from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
import time,random
em=f"kg{int(time.time())}@sinaja.cyou"; un=f"kgtest{random.randint(100000,999999)}"
print("email:",em,"| user:",un)
with sync_playwright() as p:
    b=p.chromium.launch(headless=False,args=["--no-sandbox"])
    ctx=b.new_context(viewport={"width":1366,"height":900})
    pg=ctx.new_page()
    pg.goto("https://www.kaggle.com/account/login?phase=startRegisterTab",wait_until="domcontentloaded",timeout=90000)
    pg.wait_for_timeout(5000)
    pg.click("text=Register with Email"); pg.wait_for_timeout(6000)
    pg.fill('input[name="email"]',em)
    pg.fill('input[name="password"]',"Kaggle!2026xyz")
    pg.locator('input[placeholder="Enter your full name"]').fill("Kaggle Tester")
    pg.click("text=Next"); pg.wait_for_timeout(6000)
    uinp=pg.locator('input[name="username"]')
    if uinp.count():
        uinp.fill(un); pg.wait_for_timeout(2500)
        print("nilai username:",uinp.input_value())
    pg.wait_for_timeout(5000)
    pg.click("text=Next"); pg.wait_for_timeout(10000)
    print("URL:",pg.url)
    print("BODY:",pg.inner_text("body")[:600].replace("\n"," | "))
    b.close()
